senses.gloss:
वेविजान वेविजान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.
of rt. 1. विज्), intimidating, terrifying, (Sāy. = भी-
षयत्, Ṛg-veda IV. 26, 5.)

वेविदान वेविदान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.
of rt. 1. विद्), Ved. knowing or finding out most
effectually; obtaining very much.

वेविषत् वेविषत्, अत्, अती, अत् (fr. rt. 2. विष्),
Ved. engaged in sacred rites, (Sāy. वेविषतः =
कर्माणि प्राप्नुवन्तः, Ṛg-veda VI. 21, 5.)

वेविषाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. contending with, (Sāy.
= युद्धार्थं सङ्गत, Ṛg-veda VII. 18, 15.)

वेवी वेवी (perhaps to be regarded as
an Intens. of rt. 1. वी, q. v.), cl. 2. A.
वेवीते (Ved. also P. वेवेति, 3rd pl. A. वेव्यते), &c.,
to go; to pervade, obtain; to conceive or become
pregnant; to wish, desire, love; to throw, cast, hurl;
to eat, consume.
